prompt_en: Create a candid vertical behind-the-scenes photograph of the same fictional 18-year-old Korean high-school senior shown in the attached reference image, inside a bright Korean classroom after class. She is the universally admired standout beauty of the entire province, retaining the reference's long straight dark hair, airy bangs, clear warm skin, large brown eyes, softly glossy pink lips, navy blazer, white shirt, and plaid ribbon bow. She records a vertical TikTok dance clip on a smartphone mounted to a compact desk tripod. Freeze her midway through an upbeat hand-dance between the desks, one hand near her cheek and the other extending outward, meeting the phone camera with a confident playful smile. Use a vertical 9:16 behind-the-scenes frame from beside the recording phone; place the phone and its cool live preview slightly off-center in the lower foreground while desk edges converge toward her dominant three-quarter figure. A narrow bar of warm window light crosses the floor behind her, separating her silhouette from the green chalkboard. Include scattered notebooks, believable phone-screen reflections, crisp facial detail, and natural classroom depth.
